general.prompt_ru: Расскажи, как прошёл твой день. Что было хорошего, а что — сложного?
general.prompt_en: Tell me about your day. What went well, and what was difficult?
followups: Why was that part difficult?
What would you do differently next time?
How did that make you feel?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши свои планы на выходные.
general.prompt_en: Describe your plans for the weekend.
followups: Who are you doing that with?
Have you done this before?
What are you most looking forward to?

general.prompt_ru: Если бы у тебя была неделя свободного времени, что бы ты сделал?
general.prompt_en: If you had a free week, what would you do?
followups: Why did you choose that?
Where would you go?
Who would you take with you?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о городе, в котором ты вырос.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about the city where you grew up.
followups: What do you miss most about it?
How has it changed?
Would you like to live there again?

general.prompt_ru: Какая привычка сильнее всего изменила твою жизнь?
general.prompt_en: What habit has changed your life the most?
followups: How did you start that habit?
What was hard about keeping it?
Would you recommend it to others?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши свой обычный рабочий день от начала до конца.
general.prompt_en: Describe a typical work day of yours, from start to finish.
followups: What part of the day is most productive for you?
What would you change about it?
How do you usually relax after work?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о фильме или книге, которая произвела на тебя впечатление.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about a movie or book that impressed you.
followups: What was it about?
Why did it stand out to you?
Would you recommend it to a friend?

general.prompt_ru: Какая цель для тебя сейчас самая важная?
general.prompt_en: What goal is most important to you right now?
followups: What steps are you taking toward it?
What's the biggest obstacle?
How will you know you've achieved it?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши свою идеальную субботу.
general.prompt_en: Describe your ideal Saturday.
followups: What time would you wake up?
Who would you spend it with?
What would make it perfect?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о последнем путешествии, которое тебе понравилось.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about the last trip you enjoyed.
followups: What surprised you the most?
Would you go back?
What would you tell a friend planning to go there?

general.prompt_ru: Как ты обычно принимаешь сложные решения?
general.prompt_en: How do you usually make difficult decisions?
followups: Can you give an example?
Do you ask others for advice?
How do you know you made the right choice?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши человека, который на тебя сильно повлиял.
general.prompt_en: Describe a person who influenced you a lot.
followups: What did you learn from them?
How do you stay in touch now?
What quality of theirs do you admire most?

general.prompt_ru: Какие новости на этой неделе привлекли твоё внимание?
general.prompt_en: What news caught your attention this week?
followups: What's your opinion on it?
How might it affect people?
Did it change how you think about something?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши, как ты обычно проводишь утро.
general.prompt_en: Describe how you usually spend your morning.
followups: What's the first thing you do after waking up?
Do you have a morning routine?
What would an ideal morning look like?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о навыке, который ты хочешь развить в этом году.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about a skill you want to develop this year.
followups: Why is it important to you?
How are you practicing it?
What progress have you made so far?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши свою любимую еду и почему она тебе нравится.
general.prompt_en: Describe your favorite food and why you like it.
followups: When did you first try it?
Do you cook it yourself?
What would you recommend trying with it?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о лучшем подарке, который ты когда-либо получал.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about the best gift you've ever received.
followups: Who gave it to you?
What made it so special?
What did you give in return?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши, как ты обычно проводишь время с друзьями.
general.prompt_en: Describe how you usually spend time with friends.
followups: How often do you see each other?
What do you usually talk about?
What's your favorite memory with them?

general.prompt_ru: Если бы ты мог выучить любой новый навык мгновенно, что бы ты выбрал?
general.prompt_en: If you could instantly learn any new skill, what would you choose?
followups: Why that one?
How would it change your life?
Who would you want to teach it to you if not instantly?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о традиции в твоей семье, которая тебе нравится.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about a family tradition you enjoy.
followups: How did it start?
Who usually takes part?
Would you like to pass it on?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши место, куда бы ты хотел поехать, но ещё не был.
general.prompt_en: Describe a place you'd like to visit but haven't been to yet.
followups: Why does it interest you?
What would you do there first?
Who would you want to go with?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о времени, когда тебе пришлось быстро принять решение.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about a time you had to make a quick decision.
followups: What was at stake?
Are you happy with the choice you made?
What did you learn from it?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши погоду, которую ты любишь больше всего, и почему.
general.prompt_en: Describe your favorite kind of weather and why you like it.
followups: What activities do you enjoy in that weather?
Does the weather affect your mood?
What season is it usually in?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о полезной привычке, которую ты хотел бы завести.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about a healthy habit you'd like to build.
followups: What's stopping you so far?
How would your life change with it?
What's the first small step you could take?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши свой идеальный отпуск.
general.prompt_en: Describe your ideal vacation.
followups: Would it be relaxing or adventurous?
Who would join you?
What's stopping you from taking it right now?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о человеке, с которым тебе всегда легко общаться.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about someone you always find easy to talk to.
followups: What makes conversations with them easy?
How did you meet?
What do you usually talk about?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши свою реакцию на неожиданные изменения планов.
general.prompt_en: Describe how you usually react to sudden changes of plan.
followups: Can you give a recent example?
Does it get easier over time?
What helps you adapt quickly?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о фильме, который ты бы посоветовал посмотреть всем.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about a movie you'd recommend everyone watch.
followups: What's it about?
What's your favorite scene?
Who would enjoy it the most?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши, как выглядит твой обычный выходной день.
general.prompt_en: Describe what a typical day off looks like for you.
followups: Is it different from your work days?
What do you look forward to most?
How do you feel by the end of it?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о моменте, когда ты гордился собой.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about a moment you felt proud of yourself.
followups: What led up to it?
Did anyone else notice?
How did it change your confidence?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши, как ты бы объяснил свою профессию ребёнку.
general.prompt_en: Describe how you would explain your job to a child.
followups: What part would be hardest to explain?
What would surprise them most?
Would they find it interesting?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о своей любимой поре года.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about your favorite time of year.
followups: What do you enjoy doing during it?
Does it remind you of anything?
How is it different where you live now?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши покупку, о которой ты не жалеешь.
general.prompt_en: Describe a purchase you don't regret.
followups: Why was it worth it?
How often do you use it?
Would you buy it again?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи, как ты справляешься со стрессом.
general.prompt_en: Tell me how you deal with stress.
followups: What usually causes it for you?
Does it work well?
What would you suggest to a friend who's stressed?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши свою мечту, к которой ты идёшь уже давно.
general.prompt_en: Describe a long-term dream you've been working toward.
followups: What's the biggest step you've taken so far?
What keeps you motivated?
What will it feel like to achieve it?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши на английском, чем ты занимаешься на работе.
technical.prompt_en: Describe, in English, what you do at work.
followups: What's the most challenging part of your job?
What tools or equipment do you use daily?
Who do you usually collaborate with?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи о недавней проблеме на производстве и как вы её решили.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me about a recent production problem and how it was solved.
followups: What was the root cause?
How long did it take to fix?
What did you learn from it?

technical.prompt_ru: Объясни коллеге, как работает какой-либо процесс или оборудование, которое ты хорошо знаешь.
technical.prompt_en: Explain to a colleague how a process or piece of equipment you know well works.
followups: What safety steps are involved?
What happens if it fails?
How would you train a new worker on it?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши, как ты бы объяснил задержку в проекте руководителю.
technical.prompt_en: Describe how you would explain a project delay to your manager.
followups: What caused the delay?
What's your plan to catch up?
How do you prevent this next time?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи о том, как проходит инструктаж по технике безопасности на твоём объекте.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me how a safety briefing works at your site.
followups: Who leads the briefing?
What topics are usually covered?
How often do briefings happen?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши, как ты определяешь приоритеты задач в течение дня.
technical.prompt_en: Describe how you prioritize tasks during your day.
followups: What do you do when priorities conflict?
How do you handle urgent requests?
What tools help you stay organized?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи о совещании, в котором ты недавно участвовал.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me about a meeting you recently took part in.
followups: What was decided?
Did you present anything?
What would you improve about how it was run?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши деталь или узел оборудования и его назначение, будто объясняешь новому сотруднику.
technical.prompt_en: Describe a component or piece of equipment and its purpose, as if explaining it to a new employee.
followups: What could go wrong with it?
How is it maintained?
Why is it important to the whole system?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи, как ты бы вёл переговоры с поставщиком о сроках поставки.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me how you would negotiate delivery times with a supplier.
followups: What would you say if they refuse?
What's your backup plan?
How do you build a good relationship with vendors?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши шаги, которые ты предпринимаешь при диагностике неисправности.
technical.prompt_en: Describe the steps you take when diagnosing a fault.
followups: What tools do you use?
How do you know when it's fixed?
How do you document the fix?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи, как бы ты представил новый проект руководству.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me how you would pitch a new project idea to management.
followups: What numbers would you highlight?
What objections might they raise?
How would you handle pushback?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши типичный процесс контроля качества на твоём производстве.
technical.prompt_en: Describe a typical quality control process at your workplace.
followups: What happens if a product fails inspection?
Who is responsible for the checks?
How often are standards updated?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи, как ты обучаешь нового сотрудника работе с оборудованием.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me how you train a new employee to use equipment.
followups: What's the biggest mistake beginners make?
How long does training usually take?
How do you check they've understood?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши ситуацию, когда пришлось быстро принимать техническое решение под давлением.
technical.prompt_en: Describe a situation where you had to make a quick technical decision under pressure.
followups: What was at risk?
How did you decide?
Would you decide differently now?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи, как проходит типичное совещание по статусу проекта у вас в компании.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me what a typical project status meeting looks like at your company.
followups: Who usually attends?
What gets discussed most?
How are action items tracked?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши, как ты бы объяснил техническую проблему нетехническому руководителю.
technical.prompt_en: Describe how you'd explain a technical problem to a non-technical manager.
followups: What language would you avoid?
What would you emphasize instead?
How do you check they understood?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи о случае, когда пришлось убедить коллегу изменить подход к работе.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me about a time you had to convince a colleague to change their approach.
followups: What arguments did you use?
Did it work?
What would you do differently?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши, как распределяются задачи и ответственность в твоей команде.
technical.prompt_en: Describe how tasks and responsibilities are divided in your team.
followups: Who makes the final decisions?
What happens when priorities clash?
How do you handle overlapping responsibilities?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи о самом сложном оборудовании, с которым тебе приходилось работать.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me about the most complex equipment you've worked with.
followups: What made it complex?
How did you learn to operate it?
What would you improve about it?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши, как ты готовишься к аудиту или проверке на производстве.
technical.prompt_en: Describe how you prepare for an audit or inspection at work.
followups: What usually gets checked first?
What's the most common issue found?
How do you keep documentation ready?
